test.shareText: I scored {score} in {testName}! My trait analysis: {traits}

openness.high: You are curious and enthusiastic about new things. Try new experiences and engage in creative activities.
openness.medium: You maintain a balance in accepting new things. Feel free to explore new areas while staying in your comfort zone.
openness.low: You tend to be conservative and traditional. Try to gradually accept new things and broaden your horizons.

conscientiousness.high: You are responsible and well-planned. Keep this attitude but remember to relax occasionally.
conscientiousness.medium: You maintain a good balance between responsibility and relaxation. Keep up this good state.
conscientiousness.low: You are more casual and may need to strengthen planning and responsibility. Try setting small goals.

extraversion.high: You are outgoing and social. Use this advantage but remember to have some alone time.
extraversion.medium: You balance well between socializing and solitude. This is good, adjust flexibly based on situations.
extraversion.low: You tend to be introverted and like solitude. This is fine, but try joining some small social activities.

agreeableness.high: You are friendly and easy to get along with. This is a good quality, but remember to protect your interests.
agreeableness.medium: You balance well between friendliness and independence. Keep handling relationships flexibly.
agreeableness.low: You are independent and not easily influenced. This has its merits, but try to consider others' perspectives more.

neuroticism.high: Your emotions fluctuate significantly. Learn some emotion management techniques for mental health.
neuroticism.medium: Your emotions are relatively stable. Keep this state and learn more emotion management skills.
neuroticism.low: Your emotions are very stable. This is a great trait, keep it up.

art.high: You are very interested in art. Participate in more artistic activities to develop your talent.
art.medium: You have some interest in art. Selectively participate in some artistic activities.
art.low: You have less interest in art. Try experiencing basic art forms to cultivate interest.

science.high: You are very interested in science. Follow tech news and participate in scientific activities.
science.medium: You have some interest in science. Explore scientific fields that interest you.
science.low: You have less interest in science. Start with scientific phenomena in daily life.

social.high: You are very interested in social activities. Participate in volunteer work and community activities.
social.medium: You have some interest in social activities. Selectively participate in community activities.
social.low: You have less interest in social activities. Start with small community events.

tradition.high: You value traditional values highly. This helps maintain stability, but adapt to social development.
tradition.medium: You balance well between traditional and modern values. This is a good state.
tradition.low: You lean towards modern values. Stay open while respecting traditions.

achievement.high: You focus a lot on achievement. Keep pursuing goals but maintain life balance.
achievement.medium: You handle achievement and life balance well. Keep this state.
achievement.low: You care less about achievement. This attitude is relaxed, but try setting some small goals.

activity.high: Your life is very active. Keep up this positive lifestyle.
activity.medium: Your life pace is moderate. This is a good state, maintain it.
activity.low: Your life is relatively quiet. Consider adding some activities.

health.high: You pay great attention to health. Keep up this healthy lifestyle.
health.medium: You have some focus on health. Further cultivate healthy habits.
health.low: You pay less attention to health. Focus more on health and develop good habits.
